utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I still don’t have the exact time yet — I just know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — Maple Street works, and I’m glad you’re including the porch light and fence gate. If you can, please also mention to stop by in the afternoon.

utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — the repair drive is for gathering supplies and tools folks need to fix things up. If you want, I can help keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.text: Jules: We’re still waiting on the exact time, but it’s a small repair drive for basic home fixes. I can help spread the word and line up a few more hands for sorting and deliveries if that’d be useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll send the time as soon as I get it, and we can rally a few more helpers and supplies then.

utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sam — did anything change with the repair drive since yesterday? I probably missed the latest updates.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — it moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center. Just send me the signup and setup details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — Sunday at the community center works. I’m noting the change and I’ll make sure the repair spots are updated.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I appreciate it. I’ll send any new details if they come up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — once you have the exact date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive needs, send them over and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — just send the details when you have them, and I’ll write them down for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for checking in, Nell. We’ve got a few neighbors ready to help, and I’ll keep you posted once the remaining pieces are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—thanks, Uli. Keep me posted when the last pieces are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s a neighborhood fix-up drive for small repairs. Right now Opal’s place on Maple Street still needs the porch light and fence gate checked.
